name: patch_tick_ac_direct_syscall
description: Freeze-loop patch of AC LocalPlayer.Health at 20 Hz.

extra.pointer_chain_meaning: AC 1.3.0.2 local player struct base pointer (Silme94 offsets) + Health field at struct offset 0xEC
extra.frozen_value: 100 (int32, little-endian 64 00 00 00) — full health, safe to freeze in bot match
extra.expected_fingerprint: 1x cross-process READVM_REMOTE (single pointer-chain resolve reads the player struct pointer once), 20x cross-process WRITEVM_REMOTE (each tick), all with the same base_address (resolved health field). write_span_seconds ≈ 0.95, write_rate_hz ≈ 20, distinct_write_targets == 1. Notably absent: 0x ALLOCVM, 0x PROTECTVM, 0x THREAD_CREATE_REMOTE, 0x SETTHREADCONTEXT. Discriminator vs patch_aob_ac: dominated by writes not reads; vs memorypatch: 20× the write count and nonzero write_rate_hz.
